tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Technology in Education- Beneficial or Harmful- 2
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Today we'll discuss the role of technology in modern education. As you know, technology can enhance learning by providing access to a wealth of information and interactive tools. However, many people believe that technology can be a distraction and hinder traditional learning methods. So, technology can be beneficial or harmful to learners depending on the context. But considered in general terms, has technology had a positive or negative effect on modern education as a whole? Explain your reasoning.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think technology enhances learning by making information more accessible and engaging. Tools like educational apps and online resources can cater to different learning styles and help students understand complex concepts.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Overreliance on technology prevents learners from developing critical thinking skills and solving problems independently. A well-rounded education is only possible through traditional teaching and learning methods.
